_comment: New Haven — nine-stage-generation workbook. NOT YET IMPORTED. Read-only projection only. envelope is NOW SET (derived 2026-07-31 from the MSA county list, not from the observed bbox) — see _envelope_comment for the counties used, the derivation rule and the containment cross-check.
_envelope_comment: Derived from the New Haven-Milford, CT MSA COUNTY LIST, not from the observed venue bounding box. The observed bbox is only a LOWER bound — it says where the venues we happened to find are, not where the metro is, so an envelope cut to it would reject a legitimate future venue near the metro edge. Envelope = the union of the OSM boundary-polygon bounding boxes for the 1 MSA county (New Haven)), rounded OUTWARD to 0.01 deg. Cross-check: contains all 29 geocoded venue(s) of 31 in this batch (observed lat 41.2072..41.5338, lng -73.2180..-72.5746). Connecticut abolished county government in 2022, so OSM now carries New Haven County as boundary/historic rather than boundary/administrative. The polygon is the same geography and is the unit this batch's research was scoped to, so it is used deliberately and the acceptance is explicit rather than silent.
_venue_facts_comment: wood-center / wood-gym geocoded 0 m apart and aborted the metro. They are TWO venues, but this is NOT a same-site pair — it is a bad geocode on wood-center, so it is fixed at the geocode and NOT allow-listed. wood-gym (Woodbridge Center Building Gym, 4 Meetinghouse Ln) is correct as stored. wood-center is a separate courts facility on Center Road; its address came from the town's rec1.com booking app, which lists one municipal address for every facility. The house number is deliberately OMITTED because two town sources disagree: the parks-and-fields list says "Woodbridge Tennis Courts (149 Center Road)" while the town's own 2025 tennis-court painting bid says "Address: 11 Center Road, Woodbridge, CT". An aggregator claims 160; ADR-14 bars it from settling this. Inventing a number to make the row publishable is forbidden, so the street alone is stored and the precision rules judge the result honestly.

wood-center.reason: Town of Woodbridge parks-and-fields list places the town tennis courts on Center Road, not at 4 Meetinghouse Lane (which is the Center Building / Senior Center that wood-gym correctly occupies)
wood-center.research_status_reason: The pickleball claim is not confirmed by a controlling-entity source. The town's parks-and-fields page names "Woodbridge Tennis Courts" and does not mention pickleball anywhere; the workbook's only pickleball source is the rec1.com JS booking app, which returned empty to two independent fetches. The town's 2025 tennis-court bid DOES specify pickleball striping ("Layout and stripe eight (8) pickleball lines on courts per USAPA") — but a bid solicitation specifies work to be performed, not work confirmed complete, so it is grounds for promotion to 'verified' once the 2025 work is confirmed, not grounds for publishing today.

address.reason: workbook carried "4 Meetinghouse Ln", the Senior Center's address, taken from the town-wide booking app; both town sources place these courts on Center Road. House number omitted deliberately — the two town sources give 11 and 149 and neither can settle it.
